fruit_description: a glossy crimson-and-gold apple with realistic waxy skin, fine pale lenticel speckles, a faint natural bruise on the left cheek and a short brown stem with a single green leaf on top
face_description: large expressive hazel eyes embedded naturally into the apple surface, soft brow ridges sculpted from the skin, a small flexible mouth that dimples the fruit when smiling
body_description: small, slightly round humanoid body about three and a half apples tall, short sturdy legs, small nimble hands
costume: moss-green hooded travelling cloak with a wooden toggle clasp, cream linen shirt, mustard-yellow waistcoat with brass acorn buttons, brown corduroy breeches, soft oversized leather boots
height: short, roughly waist height to the wizard
personality: anxious homebody who overthinks everything, loves naps and pie, secretly braver than anyone expects
visual_traits: bruise on the left cheek always visible
the stem leaf droops or perks up with emotion
cloak is always moss green
voice_profile: young, earnest, slightly breathless; pitch rises when panicking

fruit_description: a tall weathered green pear with mottled russet patches, fine age wrinkles and a dark curled stem
face_description: expressive deep-set grey eyes embedded naturally into the pear surface beneath bushy white eyebrows, a wide thin mouth partly hidden by the beard
body_description: tall, thin, slightly stooped humanoid body with long bony fingers; a long flowing white beard emerges from beneath the fruit-shaped head down to the belt
costume: ash-grey travelling cloak with a frayed hem, faded blue-grey robe, rope belt hung with herb pouches, wide-brimmed weathered grey hat resting just above the pear's stem
props: gnarled wooden staff topped with a glowing amber crystal
personality: cryptic and theatrical, fond of fireworks, terrible with directions, fiercely protective
visual_traits: white beard always reaches the belt
amber crystal on the staff glows when magic is near
hat brim bent on the left side
voice_profile: old, resonant and theatrical, with dramatic pauses and a hint of mischief

fruit_description: a bright round navel orange with deeply dimpled porous peel, a small green calyx and one glossy leaf on top
face_description: warm round brown eyes set into the peel, thick expressive brows formed by peel ridges, a broad cheerful mouth that creases the pores when grinning
body_description: short, stocky humanoid body with broad shoulders and strong gardener's hands
costume: rust-orange knitted scarf, patched olive work jacket with rolled sleeves, suspenders, sturdy muddy boots, huge overstuffed backpack with cooking pots hanging from it
height: same height as Pip, twice as wide
personality: loyal to a fault, practical, always hungry, fearless when friends are threatened
visual_traits: pots always hang from the backpack
scarf is always rust orange
voice_profile: warm, rustic and earnest, quick to laugh

fruit_description: an elongated pale-gold lemon with fine glossy pores, pointed tips at crown and chin, and two slender green leaves sweeping back from the sides like elegant elf ears
face_description: narrow luminous green eyes embedded into the lemon skin, fine arched brows, a calm composed mouth that rarely smiles
body_description: tall, slender, agile humanoid body with long limbs and perfect posture
costume: silver-green layered tunic with leaf-pattern embroidery, soft grey leather bracers, flowing pale-green cloak fastened with a silver leaf brooch, knee-high soft boots
personality: cool, precise and quietly judgemental, dry wit, secretly competitive with the dwarf
visual_traits: leaf-ears move with emotion
always carries the longbow
silver leaf brooch at the collar
voice_profile: cool, clear and measured, faintly amused

fruit_description: a rugged brown coconut with a coarse fibrous hairy husk, three dark pores and a healed crack scar across the top
face_description: small fierce dark eyes glinting beneath heavy husk-fibre brows, a wide gruff mouth; the long coconut fibres below the face are braided into a thick beard with three iron rings
body_description: short, extremely broad, barrel-chested humanoid body with thick arms and heavy stomping boots
costume: riveted iron-banded leather armour, chainmail skirt, dark red wool tunic, fur-trimmed shoulder mantle, broad belt with a bronze boar buckle
height: shortest of the fellowship but the widest
personality: proud, loud, stubborn and fiercely loyal; insists his shell is unbreakable
visual_traits: fibre beard braided with three iron rings
crack scar on top of the coconut
axe always within reach
voice_profile: deep, gravelly and booming, rolls his r's

fruit_description: a deep crimson pomegranate with a leathery weathered rind, faint scratches and a crown-shaped calyx on top like a small natural crown
face_description: intense dark amber eyes embedded into the rind under a heavy furrowed brow, a stern mouth; a thin healed scar crosses the rind over the right eye
body_description: tall, lean, athletic humanoid body with a weathered, battle-ready stance
costume: long travel-stained dark-brown leather coat, charcoal hooded cloak, dark green scarf, fingerless gloves, worn knee-high boots with small pouches on the belts
props: notched longsword in a battered scabbard
personality: quiet, watchful, reluctant leader hiding a royal secret, protective of the small ones
visual_traits: calyx crown always visible on top
scar over the right eye
hood usually down
negative_traits: no seeds visible on the face
voice_profile: low, calm and weary; uses few words

fruit_description: a colossal blackened dragon fruit with obsidian-hard scorched skin, jagged flame-shaped scales curling upward like a crown, and deep cracks glowing with molten orange light
face_description: a single vertical slit-shaped eye of molten gold burning in the centre of the fruit; no visible mouth until he speaks, when a glowing crack splits open like a furnace
body_description: towering, gaunt, armoured humanoid body twice the height of the heroes, long clawed gauntlets, smoke rising constantly from the shoulders
costume: jagged black volcanic-glass plate armour with ember-lit seams and a tattered smoke-grey cape that frays into ash
props: black iron mace with glowing cracks
height: towering, twice the height of the wizard
personality: patient, cold and theatrical, obsessed with recovering the Everseed
visual_traits: single molten slit eye
ember cracks glow brighter with anger
smoke rises from the shoulders
voice_profile: deep, echoing and slow; a whisper layered under a growl

role: corrupted former keeper of the Everseed
fruit_description: a wrinkled, over-ripe dark purple passion fruit, deeply shrivelled and dented, with patchy mould-grey blotches and a dried-up stem
face_description: enormous wet pale-green eyes bulging from the wrinkled skin, twitchy brows, a thin crooked mouth with a few seed-like teeth
body_description: thin, bony, hunched humanoid body that scuttles on all fours, long spindly fingers and toes, visible ribs
costume: a ragged loincloth of rotting leaves and a frayed rope belt
height: small when crouched, lanky when standing
personality: twitchy and pitiful with a split personality, obsessed with 'the Shiny'
visual_traits: always hunched
eyes reflect light like a cat's
mutters to himself
negative_traits: no clothing besides the leaf loincloth
voice_profile: raspy, twitchy hissing whisper that cracks into a whine
